gloss: hot and humid; high temperature and high humidity

definitions.gloss: hot and humid; high temperature and high humidity
definitions.explanation: Describes weather or climate conditions characterized by both high temperatures and high humidity levels.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}だ。
examples.english: Japanese summers are hot and humid.

examples.japanese: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}え→生える：02392_haeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Mold grows easily in hot and humid environments.

examples.japanese: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please store in a place away from high heat and humidity.

examples.japanese: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Because of the hot and humid climate, it's necessary to watch out for heatstroke.

notes:
A four-character compound: ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧ (high temperature) + ⟦{多湿|たしつ}→多湿：12310_tashitsu⟧ (high humidity). Extremely common when describing Japan's summer climate and frequently seen on product labels, weather forecasts, and storage instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ — hot and humid environment
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧ — hot and humid climate
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ — to avoid heat and humidity
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ — hot and humid location

USAGE:
Very commonly seen on food packaging and product labels as a storage warning: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (store away from heat and humidity). Functions as a noun but can modify nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or な.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧ — high temperature
- ⟦{多湿|たしつ}→多湿：12310_tashitsu⟧ — high humidity
- ⟦{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い→蒸し暑い：03751_mushiatsui⟧ — muggy, sultry (describes the feeling rather than the condition)
- {低温乾燥|ていおんかんそう} — low temperature and dry (the opposite condition)
